verdict.rationale: Metorial lets developers upload custom MCP server code for Metorial to host, scale, and monitor (metorial-docs-5/23), and portals let users within an org discover 'approved integrations, skills, and MCP access' (metorial-docs-9, metorial-docs-29). However, this describes private/org-scoped hosting and internal discovery, not a public marketplace where any developer can publish a server for distribution and installation by unrelated third parties — the 1200+ integrations catalog (metorial-gh-2) appears to be Metorial-curated rather than open developer submissions. Missing for 10: evidence of a public developer-submission/review process, public listing/discovery mechanism for arbitrary third-party consumers, and independent confirmation that uploaded servers become installable by users outside the uploader's own org.
